methods.network_search: Original NLDI UT and DM queries use explicit 100 km distance. Starting reach is whole and untrimmed.
methods.basin: Original unsimplified whole upstream catchments; splitCatchment=false. The local catchment is not divided at the sample point.
methods.gauge_scope: NWIS Surface Water Sites are indexed features. Query response does not establish active operation, measured parameter or sampling-period coverage.
methods.distance: Haversine from original longitude/latitude using mean Earth radius 6371008.8 m. Geographic separation is straight-line great-circle distance, not network travel distance.
methods.line_length: Sum of great-circle distances between consecutive original line vertices, reported as derived geometric length.
methods.geometry: Original GeoJSON coordinates retained unchanged in derived native layers; only provenance properties are added.
